interactions.flavorLineOne:
You open a letter written formally and stamped with the Cormorant Seal:

Rookie,

A Praxic Guardian's education never stops. You've got more to learn about yourself and your Blade, and so do I. 

If we're going to change the Order, we need to work at it. Come see me upstairs when you've got a moment.

Ever forward,
Aunor

P.S. Try the Ether Fizz House of Kings style sometime. Don't let the price on the receipt scare you off: it's worth every credit.
Collect your Exotic armor reward for completing all missions on Legendary difficulty.
Collect your Powerful Gear reward for completing all missions on Legendary difficulty.

"Years ago, my Ghost lost her voice when I got us into an ice-cold situation on one of the Cabal Emperor's Athenaeum worlds. A couple other Lights didn't make it out, but thanks to her, I did. Hand to my heart, I regret it—and I thought she and I were making progress, especially after Kepler. She's clearly holding some grudges, but—thanks for helping her just the same. Now let's see what we can do to take this fight to the Imperium." —The Drifter

Aunor speaks quietly into her earpiece, then closes the call and waves you over. "We're all set for the job on Venus, Guardian. Drifter's sent word: reality and his visions are converging. It's time."

Aunor sets down her datapad. "We need to be ready for the upcoming battles. And if that means breaking with a fundamental tradition of the Praxic Order… then that's just what I'll do." 

She beckons you forward.

We've established a tenuous business relationship with the Pikers, and Drifter has helped us set up an exchange with them: They'll bring a Splicer Shank to help us extract further data from Imperium installations on the whereabouts, defenses, and operational status of Nightfall.
The Drifter is certain that the Nine are involved with the Barant Imperium, controlling them through Bael. They've shown him a new vision, which he's about to share with you…

Aunor would like our help discovering what the newly emerged Dredgen Bael is up to, alongside the crime syndicates of Mars. 
 
Start by assisting her in targeting syndicate operatives across the system to help discover their long-term plans.

There's an empty glass on the bar behind Aunor. She pushes it away as you approach, but her hands are steady.

"Guardian. As much as I'd love to find that bastard and wring his neck… we can't." She spits the words like a curse. "Not while Nightfall's still in the sky. Taking that weapon down has to be our top priority. So, let's get started."
Defy Vanguard orders and delve into the criminal underworld of Tharsis to confront the rising Barant Imperium… Drifter is certain the Imperium and the Nine are connected.

The barkeep flags you down before you can leave the Cantina and draws your attention to a crumpled receipt tucked under Aunor's envelope. On its back side is a second note from her, this one written in far more haste:

Guardian, 

You showed me I was wrong about the Darkness. Eido showed me I was wrong about the Prophecy. The people of the City deserve to know what we're all up against—so we can face it together.

The Syndicates are scrambling for resources and territory. All eyes are on them, and that means plenty of cover for this unauthorized action.

Eido has a line on a busted broadcaster. Parts for repair have to be available somewhere, but we're coming up empty. Help us fix it. Let's blow this thing wide open. 

Ever forward,
Aunor
